response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the 14th century.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly! We must push the boundaries of what is possible. We must... we must... (he gestures grandly)...we must vaporwave our aesthetic!

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, begins to describe his vision.

KING
(to the assembly)
We will replace our traditional suits of armor with... with... (he consults a parchment)...with neon-colored, PVC-encased exoskeletons! We will adorn our castles with... with... (he waves his hand)...with holographic projections of our ancestors!

ZORVATH
(stunned)
But, Your Majesty, what about the practicalities?

KING
(waving his hand dismissively)
Practicalities, schmacticalities! We will make it work. We will... we will... (he grins maniacally)...we will make it cool!

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The king's vision begins to take shape. Knights in neon-colored exoskeletons ride by, their armor glowing with an otherworldly light. Castles are adorned with holographic projections of medieval warriors, their faces distorted in a perpetual scream of rage. Merchants hawk their wares, but instead of traditional goods, they peddle... (he consults a parchment)...vintage VHS tapes and cassette players!

PEASANTS
(whispering to each other)
What sorcery is this?

KING
(laughing)
It's not sorcery, my friends! It's... it's... (he searches for the right words)...it's vaporwave!

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, sits on a throne made of... (he consults a parchment)...of recycled plastic and circuit boards.

KING
(to the assembly)
We will make our empire the most... the most... (he grins)...the most retro-futuristic in all the land!

ZORVATH
(sarcastically)
Oh, joy. Because nothing says "futuristic" like a medieval king in a neon-colored exoskeleton.

KING
(laughing)
You just watch, Zorvath! We will make this empire... we will make this empire... (he searches for the right words)...we will make this empire vaporwave!

FADE TO BLACK.
